description: Mostly fires in the opening (4-8 stones) when nearly all of the mover's stones are in columns 1 and 3 (e.g. bottom-row X at b and d), the opponent has stones in column 0 or 4, and the opponent's last move was not in column 5 or 6. A weaker, unreliable late-game part: the opponent's last move filled the centre column. My stones in columns 4 or 6 suppress it.
effect: None measurable: steering to max or zero changes move probabilities by 0.03 or less.
notes: Layer-0 unit. Activation depends exactly on per-column stone counts for each side plus the last-move column (order and stacking invariant), but the column weights change with context, so it is nonlinear. Best dev F1 0.257 (P 0.20, R 0.35, AUROC 0.66), simulation share 0.07. An additive weight model got F1 0.14. Late-game firing (about half of all firing) is mostly not explained; filling the top of column 3 or 6 helps but is unreliable. Possibly a random direction.
